mapper.select: SELECT 'COLOR_INSTRUCTION' AS biz_type, id AS biz_id, CONCAT( COALESCE(NULLIF(instruction_no, ''), CONCAT('打色单#', id)), ' / ', COALESCE(client_name, '-'), ' / ', COALESCE(product_name, '-'), ' / ', instruction_date ) AS display_name, updater AS deleted_by, update_time AS deleted_time FROM lunaerp_production_color_instruction WHERE deleted = 1 AND status = 'PENDING' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY update_time DESC

SELECT ( (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lunaerp_production_greige_order WHERE color_instruction_id = #{instructionId} AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lunaerp_production_dyeing_order WHERE color_instruction_id = #{instructionId} AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) )
